## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintainer-visible outcome.

## Why

Explain the root cause, requirement, or source evidence behind the change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:api`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` when browser behavior changes
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant negative or failure-path checks were executed

## Risk and provenance

- [ ] No secrets, personal data, generated reports, or lecture originals are included
- [ ] Domain-rule changes cite an approved source in `docs/domain-sources.md`
- [ ] AI model, schema, credential handling, dependencies, and deletions are called out explicitly
- [ ] Deferred work and unverified checks are labeled as such
